src='''def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    blocks=[]
    for r in range(h-2):
        for c in range(w-2):
            col=g[r][c]
            if col and all(g[r+i][c+j]==col for i in range(3) for j in range(3)):
                blocks.append((r+1,c+1,col))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c,col in blocks:
        for j in range(w): out[r][j]=col
        for i in range(h): out[i][c]=col
    for r,a in [(r,col) for r,c,col in blocks]:
        for c,b in [(c,col) for r,c,col in blocks]:
            if a!=b: out[r][c]=0
    return out
